title: 軌枕耐久與承載試驗~Sleeper durability and load testing
focus: 軌枕彎曲預力疲勞與環境耐久~Sleeper bending prestress fatigue and environmental durability
summary: 軌枕耐久與承載試驗以「軌枕彎曲預力疲勞與環境耐久」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。軌枕把扣件荷載分散至道碴或支承面，軌座與中部彎矩取決於接觸分布；承載試驗和耐久試驗需要分別定義邊界與損傷指標。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。~This course develops sleeper bending prestress fatigue and environmental durability through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. Sleepers distribute fastening loads to ballast or support surfaces; rail-seat and centre moments depend on contact distribution, so load tests and durability tests need separate boundaries and damage indicators. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
history: 本課把軌枕耐久與承載試驗放在可追溯的技術演進脈絡中，不把機構研究、規範出版與個別路線通車混為一談。軌枕把扣件荷載分散至道碴或支承面，軌座與中部彎矩取決於接觸分布；承載試驗和耐久試驗需要分別定義邊界與損傷指標。下列年代欄是工程事件、相關研究或規範出版節點；除明確標明實際工程事件者外，並非本專題設備的製造或投入營運日期。工程改進的判準是能否以量測區分假說，不能只依新舊設備外觀判斷。~The course places Sleeper durability and load testing in a traceable engineering context and distinguishes institutional research, standards publication and the opening of individual lines. Sleepers distribute fastening loads to ballast or support surfaces; rail-seat and centre moments depend on contact distribution, so load tests and durability tests need separate boundaries and damage indicators. The timeline identifies engineering events, relevant research and standards-publication milestones. Unless explicitly labelled as a project event, a date is not the manufacture or commissioning date of the equipment. Improvement is assessed by whether measurements distinguish hypotheses, rather than by the apparent age of machinery.
example: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：P=60 kN, L=1.6 m；y=P*L/4=24 kN*m。只把 P 增加百分之十，y=26.4 kN*m。模型邊界：單一跨中集中力、理想簡支及準靜態；不是實際道碴支承分布；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：M=24 kN*m, Z=0.002 m3；y=M*1000/Z/1e6=12 MPa。只把 M 增加百分之十，y=13.2 MPa。模型邊界：未開裂線彈性截面且斷面模數已知；只算極纖維應力；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。~This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: P=60 kN, L=1.6 m; y=P*L/4=24 kN*m. Increasing only P with a ten-percent increase gives y=26.4 kN*m. Boundary: One central point load, ideal simple supports and quasistatic response; actual ballast support distribution is not represented; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: M=24 kN*m, Z=0.002 m3; y=M*1000/Z/1e6=12 MPa. Increasing only M with a ten-percent increase gives y=13.2 MPa. Boundary: An uncracked elastic section with known section modulus; extreme-fibre stress only; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.

units.anchor: 簡支跨中彎矩~Simply supported midspan moment
units.title: 簡支跨中彎矩~Simply supported midspan moment
units.mechanism: 跨中集中載重的彎矩取決於支點間距。本模型把 P 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 26.4 kN*m。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。單一跨中集中力、理想簡支及準靜態；不是實際道碴支承分布。使用荷載與支承距離作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；試驗支點不同會使結果不可直接比較，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Moment under a central load depends on support spacing. In this model, P is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 26.4 kN*m. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. One central point load, ideal simple supports and quasistatic response; actual ballast support distribution is not represented. Use load and support spacing as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Different test support positions prevent direct comparison; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：P=60 kN, L=1.6 m；y=P*L/4=24 kN*m。只把 P 增加百分之十，y=26.4 kN*m。模型邊界：單一跨中集中力、理想簡支及準靜態；不是實際道碴支承分布；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: P=60 kN, L=1.6 m; y=P*L/4=24 kN*m. Increasing only P with a ten-percent increase gives y=26.4 kN*m. Boundary: One central point load, ideal simple supports and quasistatic response; actual ballast support distribution is not represented; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以荷載與支承距離區分模型與觀察，先用縮尺梁支點位置、荷重元及跨中應變建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「簡支跨中彎矩」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use load and support spacing to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using scaled-beam support positions, load cell and midspan strain, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Simply supported midspan moment. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 試驗支點不同會使結果不可直接比較。這個失效與「簡支跨中彎矩」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查荷載與支承距離，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Different test support positions prevent direct comparison. This failure and a measurement bias in Simply supported midspan moment can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check load and support spacing rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.
units.misconception: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：試驗支點不同會使結果不可直接比較~This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Different test support positions prevent direct comparison.
units.practice: 重算「簡支跨中彎矩」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出單一跨中集中力、理想簡支及準靜態；不是實際道碴支承分布如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由試驗支點不同會使結果不可直接比較造成偏離的合成觀察，以荷載與支承距離說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Simply supported midspan moment, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: One central point load, ideal simple supports and quasistatic response; actual ballast support distribution is not represented. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Different test support positions prevent direct comparison. Explain which evidence in load and support spacing distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

units.anchor: 軌枕彎曲應力~Sleeper bending stress
units.title: 軌枕彎曲應力~Sleeper bending stress
units.mechanism: 彎矩除斷面模數給出線彈性極纖維應力。本模型把 M 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 13.2 MPa。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。未開裂線彈性截面且斷面模數已知；只算極纖維應力。使用斷面幾何與應變作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；開裂後仍用未裂斷面會誤估應力，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Moment divided by section modulus gives elastic extreme-fibre stress. In this model, M is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 13.2 MPa. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. An uncracked elastic section with known section modulus; extreme-fibre stress only. Use section geometry and strain as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Using an uncracked section after cracking misestimates stress; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.

Increasing only M with a ten-percent increase gives y=13.2 MPa. Boundary: An uncracked elastic section with known section modulus; extreme-fibre stress only; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以斷面幾何與應變區分模型與觀察，先用模型截面尺寸、曲率應變及裂縫起始觀察建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「軌枕彎曲應力」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use section geometry and strain to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using model section dimensions, curvature strain and crack-initiation observation, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Sleeper bending stress. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 開裂後仍用未裂斷面會誤估應力。這個失效與「軌枕彎曲應力」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查斷面幾何與應變，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Using an uncracked section after cracking misestimates stress. This failure and a measurement bias in Sleeper bending stress can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check section geometry and strain rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

units.practice: 重算「軌枕彎曲應力」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出未開裂線彈性截面且斷面模數已知；只算極纖維應力如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由開裂後仍用未裂斷面會誤估應力造成偏離的合成觀察，以斷面幾何與應變說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Sleeper bending stress, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: An uncracked elastic section with known section modulus; extreme-fibre stress only. Explain which evidence in section geometry and strain distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

units.anchor: 預力平均壓應力~Mean prestress compression
units.title: 預力平均壓應力~Mean prestress compression
units.mechanism: 平均預壓可抵消部分拉應力，但偏心也帶入彎矩。本模型把 P 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 6.6 MPa。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。預力為損失後的有效值且壓力均布；偏心彎矩另列。使用預力值與端部應變作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；忽略預力損失會高估抗裂能力，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Mean precompression offsets some tension, while eccentricity adds a moment. In this model, P is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 6.6 MPa. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Prestress is the effective value after losses and compression uniform; eccentric moment is separate. Use prestress and end-region strain as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Ignoring prestress loss overestimates crack resistance; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：P=300 kN, A=0.05 m2；y=P/A/1000=6 MPa。只把 P 增加百分之十，y=6.6 MPa。模型邊界：預力為損失後的有效值且壓力均布；偏心彎矩另列；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: P=300 kN, A=0.05 m2; y=P/A/1000=6 MPa. Increasing only P with a ten-percent increase gives y=6.6 MPa. Boundary: Prestress is the effective value after losses and compression uniform; eccentric moment is separate; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以預力值與端部應變區分模型與觀察，先用合成有效預力、截面面積及對稱軸向應變建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「預力平均壓應力」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use prestress and end-region strain to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.

units.anchor: 預力偏心彎矩~Prestress eccentric moment
units.title: 預力偏心彎矩~Prestress eccentric moment
units.mechanism: 預力筋偏離截面形心造成橫向彎曲軸的彎矩。本模型把 P 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 6.6 kN*m。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。預力軸線與截面形心相距指定偏心；只算對橫向軸的彎矩。使用預力筋位置與幾何作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；偏心正負號錯誤會顛倒有利或不利作用，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Tendon offset from the section centroid creates bending about a transverse axis. In this model, P is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 6.6 kN*m. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. The prestress line has the stated centroidal offset; only bending about a transverse axis is included. Use tendon positions and geometry as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Wrong eccentricity sign reverses beneficial and adverse action; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：P=300 kN, e=0.02 m；y=P*e=6 kN*m。只把 P 增加百分之十，y=6.6 kN*m。模型邊界：預力軸線與截面形心相距指定偏心；只算對橫向軸的彎矩；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: P=300 kN, e=0.02 m; y=P*e=6 kN*m. Increasing only P with a ten-percent increase gives y=6.6 kN*m. Boundary: The prestress line has the stated centroidal offset; only bending about a transverse axis is included; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以預力筋位置與幾何區分模型與觀察，先用模型預力筋位置、有效張力及截面正負方向建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「預力偏心彎矩」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use tendon positions and geometry to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using model tendon positions, effective tension and section sign convention, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Increasing only after with a ten-percent increase gives y=99 percent. Boundary: Comparable specimens and identical failure-test method; only the declared cycling history applies; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以循環數與破壞荷載區分模型與觀察，先用配對試件組、載荷幅值循環帳及破壞荷重建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「循環強度保留」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use cycle count and failure load to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using matched specimen groups, amplitude-cycle records and failure loads, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Cyclic strength retention. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 不同循環幅值不能只按次數比較。這個失效與「循環強度保留」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查循環數與破壞荷載，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Different amplitudes cannot be compared by count alone. This failure and a measurement bias in Cyclic strength retention can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check cycle count and failure load rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

Explain which evidence in cycle count and failure load distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

units.anchor: 動態彈模比較~Dynamic modulus ratio
units.title: 動態彈模比較~Dynamic modulus ratio
units.mechanism: 幾何質量相同時共振頻率平方比可作動態剛度指標。本模型把 f1 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 98.01 percent。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。試件質量、幾何及模態相同；頻率平方比只作剛度比例。使用共振頻率及試件質量作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；含水質量改變會干擾剛度判讀，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~At unchanged geometry and mass, squared resonance-frequency ratio indicates dynamic stiffness. In this model, f1 is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 98.01 percent. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Specimen mass, geometry and mode are unchanged; frequency-squared ratio is only a stiffness ratio. Use resonant frequency and specimen mass as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Moisture mass change confounds stiffness inference; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：f1=450 Hz, f0=500 Hz；y=(f1/f0)**2*100=81 percent。只把 f1 增加百分之十，y=98.01 percent。模型邊界：試件質量、幾何及模態相同；頻率平方比只作剛度比例；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: f1=450 Hz, f0=500 Hz; y=(f1/f0)**2*100=81 percent. Increasing only f1 with a ten-percent increase gives y=98.01 percent. Boundary: Specimen mass, geometry and mode are unchanged; frequency-squared ratio is only a stiffness ratio; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以共振頻率及試件質量區分模型與觀察，先用同模態共振頻率、試件質量含水率及支承配置建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「動態彈模比較」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use resonant frequency and specimen mass to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using same-mode resonant frequencies, specimen mass and moisture, and support configuration, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Dynamic modulus ratio. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 含水質量改變會干擾剛度判讀。這個失效與「動態彈模比較」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查共振頻率及試件質量，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Moisture mass change confounds stiffness inference. This failure and a measurement bias in Dynamic modulus ratio can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check resonant frequency and specimen mass rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.
